categories.main_business_segments: Donaldson Company operates three primary business segments: Mobile Solutions (63.4% of net sales), which provides filtration products for construction, mining, agriculture and transportation equipment; Industrial Solutions (29.6% of net sales), which serves industrial customers with air filtration, gas purification, hydraulics and aerospace/defense products; and Life Sciences (7.0% of net sales), which provides bioprocessing equipment, food and beverage filtration, and specialized filtration for semiconductors and electric vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include proprietary filtration media such as PowerCore® and Ultra-Web® for air filtration, Synteq® XP synthetic media for fuel and hydraulic systems, and advanced bioprocessing equipment including bioreactors and fermenters. Manufacturing utilizes both traditional filtration production and advanced bioprocessing manufacturing techniques, with the company operating 75 manufacturing and distribution centers globally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in construction, mining, agriculture, transportation, power generation and aerospace sectors, as well as independent distributors, dealers and direct end-users. Key end markets are construction and mining equipment, commercial vehicles, industrial manufacturing, power generation, aerospace and defense, food and beverage processing, and semiconductor/disk drive manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally across six continents with over 150 locations. Major geographic segments include U.S. and Canada (42.7% of revenue), Europe, Middle East and Africa (29.4%), Asia Pacific (17.7%), and Latin America (10.2%). The company maintains manufacturing and distribution centers, administrative offices and research facilities across all major regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Donaldson operates across multiple supply chain positions: as a supplier to OEMs for original equipment filtration systems (upstream/midstream), as a provider of replacement parts and aftermarket products (downstream), and as a direct service provider to end-users. The company sources raw materials including steel, filter media and petrochemical products from third-party suppliers, representing approximately 70% of cost of sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include extending market access through bioprocessing acquisitions and alternative power solutions, expanding technologies and solutions through connected service offerings and battery vent products for electric vehicles, and pursuing strategic acquisitions in high-margin areas. R&D spending was $78.1 million (2.3% of sales) in fiscal 2023, focused on material science capabilities and new product development performed substantially in-house.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of filtration equipment, replacement parts and consumables sold to OEMs, distributors and end-users. Revenue is recognized at point of sale when control of goods transfers to customers. The company also generates revenue from limited services and installation work, with some contracts recognizing revenue over time using input or output methods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Donaldson is a market leader in many of its product lines, particularly in Off-Road and On-Road OEM filtration and in the Aftermarket replacement filter business. The Mobile Solutions segment faces competition from several large global competitors and many regional competitors. Industrial Solutions competes with large global and numerous smaller regional competitors. Life Sciences faces competition from large global players and niche specialists. Competition is based on technology, innovation, price, geographic coverage, service and product performance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Donaldson is a large-cap company with fiscal 2023 net sales of $3,430.8 million and net earnings of $358.8 million. The company achieved 3.8% revenue growth in fiscal 2023 and 15.9% growth in fiscal 2022. Diluted EPS was $2.90 in fiscal 2023 versus $2.66 in fiscal 2022. The company maintains strong liquidity with $187.1 million in cash and $396.3 million in available revolving credit capacity as of July 31, 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Donaldson differentiates through proprietary filtration technologies (PowerCore®, Ultra-Web®, Synteq® XP), a broad portfolio of over 2,800 issued patents, strong brand recognition with trademarks like Donaldson® and Torit®, global manufacturing and distribution network, and commitment to innovation and customer service. The company emphasizes reliability, performance, and ability to solve complex filtration challenges across diverse industries and applications.
